about_the_game:
Sweetoria Land is a vibrant 3D low-poly platformer designed for kids aged 8–15 and families, delivering a fun, creative, and meaningful adventure. Play as Milo Marshie and Lila Sweetie—two orphaned siblings—on their journey through the enchanting kingdom of Sweetoria Land. Collect sparkling Stars hidden across the colorful world to unlock Magical Portals and progress on your quest. With its charming cartoon visuals, playful sound effects, and uplifting themes about overcoming sadness, Sweetoria Land is perfect for fans of joyful platformers and heartfelt explorations.

Explore a Magical Candy Kingdom

Inspired by Germany’s Black Forest, Sweetoria Land features five delightful regions: Lollipop Forest, Waffle Village, Syrup Stream, Candy Meadow, and Candy Castle. The land is shrouded in the mysterious “Candy Famine” curse, casting shadows and sadness across every corner (Siegmund). Stuck in the whimsical Candy House by the Candy Witch—a symbol of safe but restrictive dreams (Beit)—Milo and Lila are guided by the cheerful Sweetbloom Buddy. Their mission is to find five legendary Star Cookies, unlock magical portals, escape the candy maze, brighten the Candy Witch’s heart, and sail back to Waffle Village on the Candy Boat.

A Story Full of Heart

Drawing inspiration from Grimm fairy tales and meaningful psychological themes (Bettelheim, Meyer), Sweetoria Land’s journey is a celebration of growing through fear, daring to try, developing patience, nurturing self-belief, and discovering love. As new kingdom regions open soon, Milo and Lila bravely collect Star Cookies to bring color and hope back to their playful world.

Jump, Explore, Collect

  • Use Milo’s jumping abilities—single, double, and wall jumps—to navigate lively platforms like collapsing bridges and sinking islands.

  • Collect Candy Drops as markers for hidden paths, discover Star Cookies to open portals, and find fun secrets throughout every zone.

Discover Five Distinct Regions

Each region in Sweetoria Land offers four imaginative areas (8–9 minutes each), escalating in playful challenge:

  • Lollipop Forest: A dense candy maze, challenging fear.

  • Waffle Village: Ancient bridges collapse as you learn to dare.

  • Syrup Stream: Brave sinking islands and build patience.

  • Candy Meadow: Winds foster self-belief as you leap and explore.

  • Candy Castle: An enchanting maze reveals lessons of self-love.

Playful Features for All Ages

  • Joyful Jumping: Precision platforming fun for every skill level.

  • Charming Art & Sound: Low-poly candy visuals and festive effects — “pop,” “ting,” and “boom”—fill the world with delight.

  • Heartfelt Story: Overcome sadness and restore joy—it’s a journey of hope and love.

  • Lots to Discover: Coming soon—side quests, collectible skins, and co-op gameplay will encourage repeat playthroughs and shared adventures with friends or family.

  • Family Friendly: Local co-op mode for easy drop-in fun is also coming soon—everyone will be able to play together.

Jump into Sweetoria Land for a colorful adventure where every leap spark joy and every discovery bring light back to the kingdom. Now available on Steam—come collect your Stars and brighten the world!

Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7 / 8 / 10 (32-bit or 64-bit)
  • Processor: 1.0 GHz or faster
  • Memory: 1 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated GPU
  • DirectX: Version 9.0c
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 / 11
  • Processor: 2.0 GHz dual-core or better
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Any GPU supporting DirectX 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
